purpose: Synthetic detector examples authored for this repository; these are not model outputs or a live quality benchmark.
review_notes: Each candidate retains the number 72, the map, the lantern, and the same speaker-tagged dialogue turns.
Sana asks about the gate and proposes the next need; Rowan confirms the map notation. The dialogue lines retain that distinction.
Candidates remove repeated ornamental beats and vary reply lengths. This is a deliberate editorial comparison, not evidence of automatic semantic equivalence.
Intentional repetition of a clue in dialogue remains. Review meaning, voice, readability and continuity alongside metrics; lower counts alone do not establish quality.
